outcome: Fetal umbilical cord vein and artery plasma cefuroxime concentrations
Umbilical arterial : venous plasma drug concentration ratios
Apparent volume of distribution of cefuroxime
cohort: The study included 53 pregnant women scheduled for cesarean section, divided into healthy controls, those with arterial hypertension, and those with gestational diabetes.
finding: Diabetes led to decreased placental transfer of cefuroxime, as well as reduced volume of distribution and clearance, while hypertension had no significant effect on cefuroxime permeation or pharmacokinetics.
cross-section timing: Before, during, and after delivery (at cesarean section)
